name: LeRobot–MuJoCo–VLA Tutorial
description: An end-to-end workflow for training and evaluating vision-language-action policies, from teleoperation and dataset preparation to custom policy integration. Includes π₀.₅ and GR00T N1.5.
image_alt: Pi-0.5 robot policy evaluation in MuJoCo

name: JiT Unofficial Light
description: A lightweight, unofficial JiT implementation with a Colab toy demo exploring prediction spaces and loss functions for denoising generative models.
image_alt: JiT toy experiment comparing denoising model configurations

name: CoTaP Failure Detection
description: Detect success or failure in robot manipulation videos and localize when a failure occurs, using frame, text, video, or hybrid inputs.
image_alt: Comparison of robot task verification results

name: Uncertainty-Aware Gaussian Mixture Flow Matching
description: A notebook tutorial for learning 2D trajectories with Gaussian mixture flow matching and visualizing aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty.
image_alt: Gaussian mixture flow matching trajectories and uncertainty visualizations

name: LeRobot–MuJoCo Tutorial
description: Hands-on examples for collecting demonstrations, training policies, and deploying them in MuJoCo with LeRobot. Includes ACT, π₀, and SmolVLA.
image_alt: Keyboard teleoperation and demonstration collection in MuJoCo

name: Flow Matching with PPO Fine-tuning
description: A tutorial on reinforcement learning fine-tuning of flow matching models, with toy examples for unlearning and improving sample fidelity.
image_alt: Flow matching samples after PPO fine-tuning

name: Uncertainty Estimation Baselines
description: Reference notebooks for uncertainty estimation, out-of-distribution detection, and calibration, including Gaussian processes, dropout, energy scores, and mixture logit networks.

name: Pioneer Playground
description: A ROS Noetic and Gazebo playground for a Pioneer mobile robot in a simulated house, with camera, depth, and lidar interfaces.
image_alt: Pioneer mobile robot in the Gazebo house environment

name: Robust Learning Baselines
description: A collection of label-noise learning implementations, including noise adaptation, forward correction, Co-teaching, JoCoR, and DivideMix.

name: CenterNet–MDN
description: An adaptation of CenterNet with a mixture density network, with qualitative visualizations of epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty.
image_alt: CenterNet mixture density network uncertainty results

name: Active Learning Baselines
description: Active learning baselines for MNIST and CIFAR-10, including uncertainty-based querying, greedy core-set selection, and BALD.

name: Dynamic RRT
description: RRT and RRT* path planning examples with moving obstacles, including visualizations of search-tree construction.
image_alt: RRT star search tree growing around moving obstacles

name: Peg-in-Hole
description: Reinforcement learning experiments for peg insertion, exploring DQN, DDPG, PPO, recurrent policies, and hindsight experience replay.
